field.label: Hosts
field.helpText: Redis endpoint as host:port (note the colon). For OSS Cluster you may provide one or more comma-separated seed nodes (host1:port1,host2:port2) - any reachable seed is enough; the client discovers the rest of the topology. For Single Endpoint, provide the single endpoint.

field.label: Clustering Policy
field.helpText: How the target Redis presents its topology to the client. Single Endpoint: the client talks to one address; no cluster routing. Use for a single Redis node or a proxy-fronted cluster that presents one endpoint (e.g. Redis Enterprise / Redis Cloud "Enterprise" clustering policy, Azure Cache for Redis Basic/Standard). OSS Cluster: a client-sharded Redis Cluster (MOVED/ASK redirects); the client discovers the topology and routes keys itself. Use for Redis OSS cluster mode, AWS ElastiCache (cluster mode enabled), or Azure Managed Redis with the OSS clustering policy.

field.label: Use SSL
field.helpText: Default non-SSL port is 6379. Default SSL port is 6380.

field.label: Authentication Type
field.helpText: Provide the authentication type. Select Microsoft Entra Client Secret Credential for Azure Cache for Redis.

field.label: User
field.helpText: User Name

field.label: Password
field.helpText: For Redis, you can provide a password (Access Key for Azure Redis Caches)

field.label: Microsoft Entra OAuth 2.0 Credentials
field.helpText: Used only when Authentication Type is "Microsoft Entra Client Secret Credential" (ignored otherwise). Configure the Client Credentials grant with your Azure AD App Registration: scope https://redis.azure.com/.default and token URL https://login.microsoftonline.com/{tenantId}/oauth2/v2.0/token

url.helpText: Microsoft Entra token endpoint. Default targets Azure Commercial. For Azure Government, change to https://login.microsoftonline.us/{tenantId}/oauth2/v2.0/token. Replace {tenantId} with your Azure tenant ID.

field.label: Connection Timeout (seconds)
field.helpText: Maximum time to wait for connection establishment. For Azure Redis with SSL/Auth, increase this (for example, 30 seconds).

field.label: Socket Read Timeout (seconds)
field.helpText: Maximum time to wait for read operations. For Azure Redis with SSL/Auth, increase this (for example, 30 seconds).

field.label: Enable Connection Pooling
field.helpText: Select to enable connection pooling and make other fields active. Connection pooling may increase performance by using resources more efficiently. Connection pools are per JVM.

field.label: Maximum Connections
field.helpText: Maximum pool size.

field.label: Minimum Connections
field.helpText: Minimum pool size.

field.label: Maximum Idle Time
field.helpText: Maximum idle time in seconds for connections in the pool.

field.label: Maximum Wait Time
field.helpText: Maximum wait time in seconds for a connection from the pool.

field.label: Consumer Group Name
field.helpText: Redis Stream consumer group name used by Listen operations on this connection whose Queue Type is "Stream". Not used for Queue Type "List" or by GET/UPSERT/DELETE. The connector creates the group automatically (from the beginning of the stream) if it does not already exist.

field.label: Key Prefix
field.helpText: Prefix added to all key values. Include a colon (:) at the end.

field.label: Remove Key Prefix from Response
field.helpText: Select to remove the key prefix from the response key(s).

field.label: Throw Exception when not found
field.helpText: Throw Exception when no result if found in the Cache. You will have to Catch the Exception and query the Backend System

field.label: Key Prefix
field.helpText: Prefix added to all key values.

field.label: Set Time To Live (TTL)
field.helpText: Set the time to live (TTL) in milliseconds. Set to -1 to disable a change to TTL.

field.label: Key Prefix
field.helpText: Prefix added to all key values.

field.label: Queue Type
field.helpText: List: simple, at-most-once delivery via BLPOP - a popped message is gone if the receiving process run crashes. Stream: reliable, at-least-once delivery via a Redis Stream consumer group - an unacknowledged message is automatically redelivered, and a message that keeps failing is moved to a dead-letter stream instead of retried forever. Requires "Consumer Group Name" set on the connection.

field.label: Queue Key
field.helpText: The Redis key to consume (the List or Stream name).

field.label: Singleton Mode
field.helpText: When enabled, only one node in a Molecule/clustered Atom runs this listener at a time. When disabled (default), every node listens independently - Redis's own atomicity ensures a given message is still delivered to only one node.

field.label: Ack Mode
field.helpText: Stream Queue Type only. On process completion: acknowledges a message only after its process run finishes successfully - true at-least-once, but ties up this listener until the run completes. On submission: acknowledges as soon as Boomi accepts the message - faster, but a process failure after acceptance is not redelivered.

field.label: Idle Reclaim Timeout (ms)
field.helpText: Stream Queue Type only. A pending message idle longer than this is reclaimed for redelivery (or dead-lettered, past Max Delivery Attempts). In "On Process Completion" Ack Mode, this value is also used as the maximum time the listener will wait for a process execution to finish before treating it as timed out and leaving the message unacknowledged for reclaim -- tuning this field therefore also changes how long a slow process is given before it is abandoned.

field.label: Max Delivery Attempts
field.helpText: Stream Queue Type only. Beyond this many delivery attempts, a message is moved to the dead-letter stream instead of redelivered again.

field.label: Dead Letter Key
field.helpText: Stream Queue Type only. Redis Stream key for messages that exceeded Max Delivery Attempts. Defaults to "<Queue Key>:dead-letter" when left blank.

field.label: Poll Block (ms)
field.helpText: Blocking timeout per poll iteration (BLPOP timeout / XREADGROUP BLOCK).

field.label: Queue Type
field.helpText: List: pushes with RPUSH (paired with a List-mode Listen's BLPOP for FIFO order). Stream: pushes with XADD (paired with a Stream-mode Listen).
